annotations.title: Invoice check: validate an EU invoice before paying

description: Check an invoice in one call: send a PDF, Word or Excel file, scan or photo (URL or POST body). It reads the fields, checks the seller's and buyer's VAT numbers in EU VIES with the registered name, validates the IBAN and its country, recomputes net + VAT = total and the line items, and checks the dates. Returns pass, review or fail with each check. Use before paying a supplier invoice; for e-invoice XML (XRechnung, ZUGFeRD): pack_einvoice_check. Price $0.05/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

url.description: Absolute public http(s) URL of the invoice file (or send the file in a POST body instead)
